name: Rally
description:
Once per rest: If your current Endurance is less than half its maximum, regain Endurance equal to your BODY score.

Describe how you find a reserve of strength.

improvements.name: Second Wind
improvements.description: You may spend 1 MP to use the Rally ability a second time per rest.

improvements.name: Iron Heart
improvements.description: Whenever you spend MP with Rally to regain Endurance, you instead regain twice your BODY score.

improvements.name: Rallying Cry
improvements.description: When you use your Rally ability, you may spend 2 MP to have any adjacent allies also regain Endurance equal to their BODY scores.
